model_meta.budget_note: hidden layer sized to match a quantum model's parameter count for parameter-efficiency comparison

resources.shots_note: exact statevector fidelity (equivalent to shots=inf); kernel entries are inner products of simulated quantum states

config.notes: Flagship end-to-end experiment. Full classical suite + full quantum suite. Compute-reduced protocol for the sandbox demo (5-fold outer CV, 3 seeds); the full research protocol (inner-CV tuning enabled, 10 seeds) is configurable here and used by scripts/reproduce.py --full.

research_status: RESEARCH AND EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY — not a medical device, not clinically validated, not for diagnosis.

conformal.note: inductive conformal (LAC) on pooled out-of-fold predictions; calibration split 60/40

ablation.interpretation: Same-parameter-count comparison; differences within noise are reported as no measurable contribution. The result is whatever the experiment actually shows.

rff.method: Random Fourier Features (surrogate of quantum kernel distances)
rff.note: classical kernel approximation evaluated on identical test folds

nystrom.method: Nystrom low-rank approximation of quantum kernel
nystrom.note: classical low-rank surrogate evaluated on identical test folds

compressed_space_baseline.model: logistic regression on squashed compressed features

bottleneck_honesty_meter.reading: quantum layer adds measurable value beyond the classical compressed representation
bottleneck_honesty_meter.purpose: measures how much predictive performance comes from classical feature compression versus the quantum layer

configuration.note: threshold is configurable and recorded; the band is not assumed universally optimal
